name: Graveyard field colors
notes: Night meadow: 1-3 grass from shadow to blade tips, 4-6 grave stone (body, moonlit top, outline), 7 bone, 8-9 dirt and bark, a-d the forest canopy from its dark outline to the moonlit leaf edges, e/f yellow and purple flowers. The scene backdrop (#2a4a30) is the bare grass between them.
